scope: Targeted static source review of task/agent/repository/session models; SQLite initialization and transaction implementation; task create, manual claim, automatic poll, capacity/affinity/harness/budget selection, alternate progress/finish writers and terminal guards; output schema/citation boundaries; delegation/defer/follow-up/context; task/session heartbeat, stale CAS, supersede/resume dependency repair, cancel and runner reconciliation; selected workflow step execution/checkpoint fences, validation and HITL approval paths; token/core admission and legacy progress rights; durable messages/read cursors; representative dashboard queries/board/detail/pause rollback and container/compose deployment. Selected test assertion bodies read. Historical Wingman probes not rerun or relabeled. Not every-line, all providers/integrations/extensions/migrations/script sandboxes/storage/security/browser/accessibility/performance/high availability/runtime or production race certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Parent-inherited task context, explicit status/assignee/dependsOn/source/schema; transactional insertion with workflow actionability and selected tracker dedup; MCP routing and duplicate handling, no universal request idempotency claim.
lifecycle_review.select: Assigned pending path checks dependencies; automatic pool candidate helper checks affinity and supplied harness compatibility without dependency readiness, then budget/claim. Static path inconsistency, not runtime reproduced; cycle failure traversal bounded but no proven cycle-admission policy.
lifecycle_review.claim: Manual tool wraps capacity, readiness, affinity/runtime checks and atomic status=unassigned SQL in transaction. Poll is transactional acquisition but policy differs. Legacy progress policy allows unassigned writes; explicit-task MCP progress/finish can avoid claim, subject to token posture/extension restrictions.
lifecycle_review.progress: Stable task progress/outcome, logs, attachments/citations/context; update by task ID with terminal protections in public handler, no universal current-attempt generation. Read cursor advances to now after limited/filtered retrieval or posting, so omitted entries can become read; durable history remains.
lifecycle_review.review: MCP fresh completion schema validation and at-most-once citation refusal; HTTP fresh finish lacks equivalent server schema gate. Custom JSON Schema subset. Authored workflow validation and human approval nodes/checkpoints have stronger bounded contract, not global ordinary-task acceptance.
lifecycle_review.complete: First terminal result wins with explicit text correction guard; completeTask nonterminal guard, no ordinary accepted-child join or immutable reviewed-result requirement. Deferred segment can finish while continuation remains. Memory/rating/lead follow-up effects can fail separately after primary state.
lifecycle_review.cancel: Guarded terminal write, dependent cascade, steering promotion and after-commit signals. Runner later aborts local session and can force slot release after grace; no proof of OS death or external side-effect reversal. Task pause is state transition, not universal process freeze.
lifecycle_review.recover: Task/session heartbeat classifier, lastUpdatedAt CAS and capped resume generations; boot guards and superseded gap repair; never-started dependencies repointed; fresh provider sessions get bounded ancestor preamble. Workflow retryCount fences reject stale checkpoint commits, ordinary task writes lack same universal attempt fence. Shared API/SQLite authority across hosts, no proven replicated/offline ownership or HA.
